mapper.select: SELECT b.user_id, b.task_id, b.binding_id, t.plan_version, t.status AS task_status, (t.cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL) AS cancellation_requested, c.generation AS conversation_generation, c.status AS conversation_status FROM sq_runtime_binding b JOIN sq_goal_task t ON t.user_id = b.user_id AND t.task_id = b.task_id JOIN sq_conversation c ON c.user_id = t.user_id AND c.conversation_id = t.conversation_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.framework_session_id = #{sessionId} AND b.role = 'MASTER' AND c.active_task_id = t.task_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, plan_id, user_id, task_id, plan_version, status, logical_key, definition_json, signal_version, version, goal_revision FROM sq_plan WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND logical_key = #{logicalKey} ORDER BY plan_version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT plan_version FROM sq_goal_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sq_goal_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL

SELECT id, plan_id, user_id, task_id, plan_version, status, logical_key, definition_json, signal_version, version, goal_revision FROM sq_plan WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND plan_version = #{planVersion} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sq_worker_job WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND plan_version = #{planVersion} AND status IN ('READY', 'RUNNING', 'WAITING_INPUT', 'WAITING_APPROVAL', 'RECONCILING', 'CANCELLING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sq_plan WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND plan_version = #{planVersion} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_plan SET signal_version = signal_version + 1, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND plan_version = #{planVersion} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT id, job_id, user_id, task_id, plan_version, node_key, worker_key, worker_version, status, depends_on_json, input_json, result_candidate_json, result_json, binding_id, reused_from_job_id, cancel_requested_at, version FROM sq_worker_job WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND plan_version = #{planVersion} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, job_id, user_id, task_id, plan_version, node_key, worker_key, worker_version, status, depends_on_json, input_json, result_candidate_json, result_json, binding_id, reused_from_job_id, cancel_requested_at, version FROM sq_worker_job WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND plan_version = #{planVersion} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_plan (plan_id, user_id, task_id, plan_version, logical_key, status, definition_json, signal_version, goal_revision, creator_id, creator_name, last_updater_id, last_updater_name) VALUES (#{planId}, #{userId}, #{taskId}, #{planVersion}, #{logicalKey}, 'ACTIVE', #{definitionJson}, #{signalVersion}, #{goalRevision}, #{userId}, '', #{userId}, '')

INSERT INTO sq_worker_job (job_id, user_id, task_id, plan_version, node_key, worker_key, worker_version, status, depends_on_json, input_json, creator_id, creator_name, last_updater_id, last_updater_name) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{userId}, #{taskId}, #{planVersion}, #{nodeKey}, #{workerKey}, #{workerVersion}, #{status}, #{dependsOnJson}, #{inputJson}, #{userId}, '', #{userId}, '')
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_worker_job SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', result_json = #{resultJson}, reused_from_job_id = #{sourceJobId}, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND job_id = #{jobId} AND status IN ('READY', 'BLOCKED') AND binding_id IS NULL
UPDATE sq_worker_job SET binding_id = #{bindingId}, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND job_id = #{jobId} AND status = 'READY' AND binding_id IS NULL

UPDATE sq_worker_job SET status = 'READY', binding_id = #{bindingId}, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND job_id = #{jobId} AND status = 'BLOCKED' AND binding_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_plan p WHERE p.task_id = sq_worker_job.task_id AND p.plan_version = sq_worker_job.plan_version AND p.status = 'ACTIVE')

UPDATE sq_goal_task SET plan_version = #{planVersion}, status = 'RUNNING', version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND plan_version = #{expectedPlanVersion} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL
UPDATE sq_plan SET status = 'SUPERSEDED', version = version + 1 WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND plan_version < #{planVersion} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE sq_worker_job SET status = 'SUPERSEDED', version = version + 1 WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND plan_version < #{planVersion} AND status IN ('BLOCKED', 'READY')

UPDATE sq_command SET status = 'CANCELLED', delivery_token = NULL, delivery_lease_until = NULL WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'DELIVERING') AND binding_id IN (SELECT binding_id FROM sq_worker_job WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND plan_version < #{planVersion} AND status = 'SUPERSEDED' AND binding_id IS NOT NULL)
UPDATE sq_command SET status = 'CANCELLED', delivery_token = NULL, delivery_lease_until = NULL WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND action = 'MASTER_SIGNAL' AND status IN ('PENDING', 'DELIVERING')

UPDATE sq_worker_job SET status = 'SUPERSEDED', cancel_requested_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, guard_token = NULL, guard_lease_until = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND plan_version < #{planVersion} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'WAITING_INPUT', 'WAITING_APPROVAL', 'RECONCILING')
